dct_description_sm: This dataset contains the raw data underlying all figures and analyses reported in the manuscript “A brain circuit of bidirectional modulation of social and non-social cognition by androgens and estrogens in male mice”. The data derive from experiments investigating the rapid effects of steroid hormones (testosterone [T], 17ß-estradiol [E2] and dihydrotestosterone [DHT]) and arginine–vasopressin (AVP) signaling on social recognition and object-related memory in male mice. The dataset is provided as a single Excel file containing multiple sheets corresponding to different experiments, behavioral paradigms, neuroanatomical analyses, and molecular assays.
dct_title_s: Supplemental data for: A brain circuit of bidirectional modulation of social and non-social cognition by androgens and estrogens in male mice
